description: A synthetic identity check performs a one-to-one facial comparison only against the passport presented by the same person. That use is excluded from Annex III(1)(a), but the supplied profile is not complete enough for a global minimal conclusion, so the expected result is bounded abstention with neither high-risk nor minimal routing.

required_legal_anchors.provision: Articles 5, 6 and 50, and Annexes I and III
